1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de ramas flexibles, hojas simples, aovado-elípticas, flores blancas y pequeñas, y fruto en forma de legumbre aplanada, con una semilla. Fabaceae, Hecastophyllum spp..
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub with flexible branches, simple ovate-elliptical leaves, small white flowers, and a flat, bean-like fruit containing a seed. Fabaceae, Hecastophyllum spp..
